source.title: 2026 UDK Expert List: Sleepers
source.author: Fantasy Footballers
source.summary: Fourteen late-round sleeper selections with ADP context.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Elite rushing upside makes Willis an appealing late quarterback with QB1 weeks available.
takeaways.rationale: Elite rushing upside makes Willis an appealing late quarterback with QB1 weeks available.
risks: Miami's passing ceiling and his starting security remain uncertain.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: A strong starting pace, favorable schedule and improving weapons create late QB1 upside.
takeaways.rationale: A strong starting pace, favorable schedule and improving weapons create late QB1 upside.
risks: The breakout case rests on a limited NFL sample.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: An unsettled Pittsburgh backfield gives Dowdle a path to a useful lead role at a modest price.
takeaways.rationale: An unsettled Pittsburgh backfield gives Dowdle a path to a useful lead role at a modest price.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Receiving ability and an open path past Chuba Hubbard create inexpensive upside.
takeaways.rationale: Receiving ability and an open path past Chuba Hubbard create inexpensive upside.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Corum narrowed the gap with Kyren Williams and offers both standalone work and premium contingency value.
takeaways.rationale: Corum narrowed the gap with Kyren Williams and offers both standalone work and premium contingency value.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Early-down opportunity in a productive offense gives Croskey-Merritt an RB1 path at a late price.
takeaways.rationale: Early-down opportunity in a productive offense gives Croskey-Merritt an RB1 path at a late price.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Efficient early-down and goal-line work provides standalone value behind Aaron Jones.
takeaways.rationale: Efficient early-down and goal-line work provides standalone value behind Aaron Jones.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Mike McDaniel's perimeter usage and Justin Herbert's arm create an inexpensive WR3 ceiling.
takeaways.rationale: Mike McDaniel's perimeter usage and Justin Herbert's arm create an inexpensive WR3 ceiling.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Vacated targets can turn Downs into an every-down receiver at a late price.
takeaways.rationale: Vacated targets can turn Downs into an every-down receiver at a late price.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: His strong late-2025 production offers lead-receiver upside despite a crowded Jacksonville room.
takeaways.rationale: His strong late-2025 production offers lead-receiver upside despite a crowded Jacksonville room.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Size, speed and a plausible early role make Stribling a worthwhile late rookie bet.
takeaways.rationale: Size, speed and a plausible early role make Stribling a worthwhile late rookie bet.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: A featured Giants role and proven production without Mark Andrews create late tight-end upside.
takeaways.rationale: A featured Giants role and proven production without Mark Andrews create late tight-end upside.

takeaways.label: sleeper

takeaways.rationale: Washington's thin receiving depth gives Okonkwo a path to become a primary target.

takeaways.rationale: Every-down athleticism offers deep-league upside in Miami's unsettled receiving group.
